ev.head: qaqa
ev.sense: A member of an Azerbaijani hillbilly subculture embracing meykhana music, exhibiting materialistic flamboyancy and A.U.E. culture appreciation, using a blend of Russian and Azerbaijani slang words, and wearing matching sport suits, sunglasses, haircuts and shoes called makasin.

o.text: From Persian کوچه (kuče, “alley”). Related to Turkmen köçe, Kazakh көше (köše), Kyrgyz көчө (köcö), Uzbek koʻcha, Uyghur كوچا (kocha).

From Proto-Turkic *ogrï (“thief”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰆𐰍𐰺𐰃 (oγrï /⁠uǧr¹i⁠/, “thief”), Karakhanid اُغْریٖ (oγrï), Turkish uğru, Uyghur ئوغرى (oghri), Uzbek oʻgʻri, Kazakh ұры (urı), Kyrgyz ууру (uuru), Bashkir уғры (oğrı), Yakut уор (uor), Chuvash вӑрӑ (vără).
The sense career criminal is likely a 20th century semantic loan from Russian вор в законе (vor v zakone).
From Old Turkic 𐰴𐰍𐰣 (k¹g¹n¹), ultimately from Proto-Turkic *kagan. Doublet of xan.
From başı + qapaz + -lı. Literally, “he/she has a slap on his/her head”.
